title: hashspan: transaction and payment spans
description: hashspan's spans in Grafana Tempo: confirm spans with their outcome and fees, x402 payments, and failed or slow JSON-RPC requests. Needs a Tempo data source; the service and chain lists come from the Prometheus data source of metrics.json.

options.content: The tables query Tempo (TraceQL); the Service and Chain id lists come from hashspan's metrics in Prometheus. Service matches `service.name`, which is Prometheus' `job` when `service.namespace` is not set. The chain filter matches the span name (`confirm 8453`, `payment 8453`); JSON-RPC spans are named after their method, so their tables filter by service only. Payments have no metrics: their tables come from `payment` spans alone and stay empty without @hashspan/x402.

panels.title: Confirm spans
panels.description: Outcome, fee and revert reason of each confirm span. A replaced transaction ends as replaced, and the mined one has a confirm span of its own.

targets.query: {resource.service.name =~ "${job:regex}" && span.blockchain.operation.name = "confirm" && name =~ "confirm (${chain:regex})"} | select(span.blockchain.tx.status, span.error.type, span.blockchain.tx.fee, span.blockchain.tx.revert.reason)

panels.title: Fees of confirm spans (wei)
panels.description: blockchain.tx.fee is the total fee in wei; blockchain.tx.l1_fee is its L1 data fee part on OP-stack chains, recorded on the span only. Fees come from the sealed receipt.

targets.query: {resource.service.name =~ "${job:regex}" && span.blockchain.operation.name = "confirm" && name =~ "confirm (${chain:regex})" && span.blockchain.tx.fee != nil} | select(resource.service.name, span.blockchain.tx.fee, span.blockchain.tx.l1_fee, span.blockchain.tx.effective_gas_price, span.blockchain.tx.gas.used)

panels.title: Payments
panels.description: x402 payments of @hashspan/x402. blockchain.payment.verified is set when the settlement receipt was checked, and absent when no check was possible.

targets.query: {resource.service.name =~ "${job:regex}" && span.blockchain.operation.name = "payment" && name =~ "payment (${chain:regex})"} | select(resource.service.name, span.blockchain.payment.status, span.blockchain.payment.verified, span.blockchain.payment.amount, span.blockchain.payment.settled_amount, span.x402.scheme, span.error.type)

panels.title: Payments not verified or failed
panels.description: Payments whose settlement did not carry them, or that failed. Empty while every payment succeeds.

targets.query: {resource.service.name =~ "${job:regex}" && span.blockchain.operation.name = "payment" && name =~ "payment (${chain:regex})" && (span.blockchain.payment.verified = false || status = error)} | select(resource.service.name, span.blockchain.payment.status, span.blockchain.payment.verified, span.error.type)

panels.title: Failed JSON-RPC requests
panels.description: JSON-RPC spans of traceTransport() that failed, without the eth_call answered with code 3 (execution reverted) that replays a reverted transaction to decode its reason. Empty while no request fails.

targets.query: {resource.service.name =~ "${job:regex}" && span.rpc.system.name = "jsonrpc" && status = error && (span.rpc.method != "eth_call" || span.rpc.response.status_code != "3")} | select(resource.service.name, span.rpc.method, span.error.type, span.rpc.response.status_code)

panels.title: Slow JSON-RPC requests (over 2 s)
panels.description: JSON-RPC spans of traceTransport() that took more than 2 seconds.
